About Indian Broker Test

An independent publication with one job: put the published facts about Indian brokers side by side, honestly.

By the Indian Broker Test editorial desk · Published 9 July 2026 · Data last reviewed 10 July 2026 · Independent

Broker comparison in India has a data problem. Most "fastest broker" and "best broker" pages are written by brokers about themselves, filled with unverifiable superlatives, or padded with invented numbers to make tables look complete. Indian Broker Test exists to do the opposite: compare brokers only on what is actually published, cite the source for every figure, and write Not Disclosed - prominently - wherever the data simply does not exist.

The site is static, fast, ad-free at launch (a sidebar slot is reserved for clearly labelled ads in future, and any advertising will never influence data or rankings), and carries no affiliate links. Rankings are computed from the dataset at build time; there is no mechanism to favour any broker, and no broker has any relationship with this publication. The full rules are in the methodology.

Nothing on this site is investment advice. Investments in securities markets are subject to market risks; read all related documents carefully before investing, and verify every figure on the broker's official website before acting on it.
